Here are comprehensive unit tests for the `trie_insert_search` function using pytest style. The tests cover happy paths, edge cases, and error cases:

```python
import pytest

def test_trie_insert_search():
    insert, search = trie_insert_search()

    # Test 1: Happy path - insert and search existing word
    insert("apple")
    assert search("apple") == True

    # Test 2: Happy path - search non-existent word
    assert search("app") == False

    # Test 3: Happy path - multiple inserts and searches
    insert("app")
    assert search("app") == True
    assert search("apple") == True
    assert search("application") == False

    # Test 4: Edge case - empty string
    insert("")
    assert search("") == True
    assert search(" ") == False  # single space is different from empty string

    # Test 5: Edge case - single character
    insert("a")
    assert search("a") == True
    assert search("b") == False

    # Test 6: Edge case - same prefix different words
    insert("appetizer")
    assert search("app") == True
    assert search("appetizer") == True
    assert search("apple") == True
    assert search("applet") == False

    # Test 7: Edge case - case sensitivity
    insert("Apple")
    assert search("Apple") == True
    assert search("apple") == False  # different case

    # Test 8: Edge case - special characters
    insert("a@b")
    assert search("a@b") == True
    assert search("a@") == False

    # Test 9: Edge case - numbers
    insert("123")
    assert search("123") == True
    assert search("12") == False

    # Test 10: Edge case - unicode characters
    insert("café")
    assert search("café") == True
    assert search("cafe") == False

    # Test 11: Error case - non-string input (should not raise, but won't work)
    # Note: The current implementation doesn't handle non-string inputs,
    # so we're just testing that it doesn't raise an exception
    try:
        insert(123)
        assert search(123) == False
    except Exception:
        pytest.fail("Inserting non-string should not raise an exception")

    # Test 12: Error case - None input
    try:
        insert(None)
        assert search(None) == False
    except Exception:
        pytest.fail("Inserting None should not raise an exception")

    # Test 13: Edge case - very long word
    long_word = "a" * 1000
    insert(long_word)
    assert search(long_word) == True
    assert search("a" * 999) == False

    # Test 14: Edge case - word with only end marker
    insert("$")
    assert search("$") == True
    assert search("") == True  # previously inserted empty string

    # Test 15: Edge case - multiple end markers in different branches
    insert("a$b")
    assert search("a$b") == True
    assert search("a$") == False
    assert search("$b") == False

    # Test 16: Edge case - overlapping words with different endings
    insert("bat")
    insert("batman")
    assert search("bat") == True
    assert search("batman") == True
    assert search("batm") == False

    # Test 17: Edge case - word that is a prefix of another word
    insert("car")
    insert("carpet")
    assert search("car") == True
    assert search("carpet") == True
    assert search("carp") == False

    # Test 18: Edge case - multiple inserts of same word
    insert("duplicate")
    insert("duplicate")
    assert search("duplicate") == True

    # Test 19: Edge case - search after multiple inserts
    insert("test1")
    insert("test2")
    insert("test")
    assert search("test") == True
    assert search("test1") == True
    assert search("test2") == True
    assert search("testing") == False

    # Test 20: Edge case - empty trie after inserts
    new_insert, new_search = trie_insert_search()
    assert new_search("anything") == False
```
